newsitem.title: GREECE: Banks buy 200 mln ecus for drachmas at Greek fix.
newsitem.headline: Banks buy 200 mln ecus for drachmas at Greek fix.

text.p: Greek and foreign commercial banks bought a total of 200 million ecus for drachmas at the central bank's fixing and ecu/drachma continued to crawl higher to 302.69 from 302.510, dealers said.
Forex outflows of about $400 million took place on Monday evening, aggravating the liquidity shortage in the Greek money markets.
Short-term money rates firmed another 20 basis points since this morning on concerns about liquidity, the unclear tax status of government securities and a crisis at the Athens bourse.
